  - Security reviewer: Alex Johnson (Security lead) responsible for SOC 2, pen-test acceptance and data flow review.
  - Procurement: timing TBD but expected to require SOW + PO; likely collaboration between finance + procurement.

Agreed next steps:
1) We'll send the SOC 2 report and high-level pen test summary + answers to your data retention / audit log questions by EOD Tue (May 12).
2) Ben will scope a recommended Dedicated configuration and estimated monthly commit for your workload (target by Wed).
3) You to confirm procurement timeline and any specific contract terms (e.g., data residency, subcontractor lists).

I've attached a short "security evidence checklist" we use to track what's outstanding. If any of the stakeholder names/roles above need adjustment, let us know.

Thanks looking forward to moving this along.

Subject: Re: Quantix discovery recap security evidence delivery (SOC 2 + pen test + logs)

Alex / Priya attaching the SOC 2 report (2025) and the redacted pen-test summary. Below are quick answers to the audit log / retention questions you called out: 

- Audit logs / per-request telemetry: Redwood emits JSON-formatted audit logs that include request_id, timestamp (ISO 8601), caller identity (API key / route), model_id, token counts, and response codes. Logs are accessible via Console and can be exported to S3 or your SIEM via secure delivery (TLS + presigned S3).
- Retention controls: Default retention is 90 days. For enterprise Dedicated/Private customers we support configurable retention windows up to 7 years; the config can be set per-route and enforced via policy (we can set a 12-month retention for Quantix).
- Export / on-demand: Logs exports are available via console export or programmatic API; we can also set up scheduled delivery to your S3 bucket.

Attachments included: SOC2-report-2025.pdf (stub), pen-test-summary-2025.pdf (stub), security-evidence-checklist-quantix.xlsx (updated).

Next steps from us: Ben will follow up with a Dedicated sizing + cost recommendation tomorrow; I'll prepare a short statement for procurement describing data residency and subcontractors.

If you want a technical sync with our infra/security PM, we can schedule a 30-min call this week  Ben and Dev are available Wed/Thu afternoon PT.

Best,
Marissa

Subject: Dedicated sizing & rough commit estimate for Quantix (follow-up)

Priya / Marissa as promised, a short follow-up on sizing based on the usage numbers Marissa captured:

- Estimated steady-state concurrency: 250 reqs/s; avg session 1200 tokens -> we recommend a Dedicated pool of 8 x A100-equivalent GPUs with autoscale headroom for spikes.
- Expected median latency: ~250-350ms (model and quantization dependent).
- Estimated monthly commit (reserved): $85,000 / month (includes 6% premium for priority routing + 24/7 support).

If Quantix needs US-only regions, we'll pin capacity to us-west-2 and us-east-1. We can also provide a trial period on Hosted API to validate latency before committing.

Action items: 
- Priya: confirm procurement timing and whether PO/SOW is required for legal.
- Marissa: I'll prepare a short appendix that lists where logs are accessible and the retention policy to include in the SOW.
- Dev: please prep a 30-min tech sync slot Thurs 14:00 PT if Quantix wants to meet.
